findings.highlight: I think I just saw a beautiful field of flowers...
findings.evidenceJa: なんか、いまバター畑が見えたような……！？
findings.governingReading: Taiga glimpses an incongruous field of butter while the bath threatens to send her to heaven.
findings.explanation: The strange field of butter becomes a conventional field of flowers. The bath's deadly comfort remains; the specific absurd image does not.

findings.evidenceJa: ヤツも歪んでるからな。
findings.governingReading: Taiga says he too is distorted/warped, explaining why his own story is central.

findings.highlight: Can we call this the grand finale?
findings.evidenceJa: これ、大団円って言っていいの？
findings.governingReading: Taiga asks whether the costly ending can count as a 大団円; Illya defends its happy resolution despite her and Saber’s deaths.
findings.explanation: A satisfying happy resolution becomes the grand finale.
